node.statement: Unpack the third clause of GT-kitaev-prop-delta-hominc using its registered implicit quantifier convention. There are universal C_unit>0, epsilon_unit>0, delta_unit>0 and a_unit>0, chosen with a_unit strictly below the positive near-unit threshold in that clause, such that every level-one delta-homomorphism f between epsilon-C*-algebras with epsilon<=epsilon_unit, delta<=delta_unit, and ||f(I)-I||<=a_unit satisfies ||f(I)-I||<=C_unit*(delta+epsilon). These constants are independent of all algebras, dimensions, maps, D, W and t.
